current_episode.title: Mastering Cash Flow Management & Business Growth with Julie Williams #193

guest.bio_context: Julie Williams has run businesses for over 35 years, starting her career at age 17 as an accounts assistant with mentors in the late 1980s during a period of business growth and acquisitions. She worked in construction and M&A, then as an area director at HSBC managing 180 customers, before leaving corporate to launch Business Oracle. She also founded a children's books business 20 years ago that remains operational, and is now building an AI-powered brand platform startup.

context.real_quote: My superpower is to borrow some of my belief until you find your own.

pending_qa.r: Julie explains that she is building an AI startup brand platform to move beyond the disgusting flyers being produced with AI everywhere that all have the same bullet points, icons, and fonts. Instead, they are creating a toolkit for someone to get going quickly with the right principles and right information. She has already created what they call a second brain containing all her podcasts and teaching that is incorporated into the AI system.
